name: counter-7-5-safe-plain
source:
---- MODULE Differential ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC
CONSTANT Nodes
VARIABLE counters
Symm == Permutations(Nodes)
Init == counters = [node \in Nodes |-> 0]
Next == \E node \in Nodes: counters' = [counters EXCEPT ![node] = IF @ < 5 THEN @ + 1 ELSE 0]
Safe == counters \in [Nodes -> 0..5]
====
config:
CONSTANT Nodes={p0,p1,p2,p3,p4,p5,p6}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Safe
